translation: prep. 经由，通过；凭借 (介词，无变形) 【易混淆词：through, by】【派生词：无】【固定搭配：via email (通过电子邮件), via the internet (通过互联网)】
example: We can communicate with people from all over the world via the Internet.
exampleTranslation: 我们可以通过互联网与世界各地的人交流。(词根：vi (路) / 构词：via (路) → 顺着路走 → 经由)

translation: n. 肘部 v. 用肘挤 (elbow-elbowed-elbowed) 【易混淆词：arm, joint】【派生词：无】【固定搭配：elbow one's way (用肘挤出一条路)】
example: He accidentally hit my elbow and made me drop my book.
exampleTranslation: 他不小心撞到了我的肘部，让我把书掉了。(词根：elb (肘) / 构词：elb (肘) + -ow → 肘部)

translation: n. 全体员工，职员 v. 为...配备职员 (staff-staffed-staffed) 【易混淆词：stuff (东西), crew (全体船员), personnel (全体人员)】【派生词：staffing (n. 人员配备)】【固定搭配：teaching staff (教职员工), staff member (职员), be staffed with (配备有...)】
example: The hospital is short of medical staff, especially experienced nurses.
exampleTranslation: 这家医院缺乏医护人员，尤其是有经验的护士。(词根：staff (棍棒/支撑) / 构词：staff (支撑) → 支撑公司的人 → 全体员工)

translation: v. 呼吁；上诉；对...有吸引力 n. 呼吁；吸引力 (appeal-appealed-appealed) 【易混淆词：apply (申请), attract (吸引)】【派生词：appealing (adj. 吸引人的)】【固定搭配：appeal to (吸引；呼吁), appeal for (恳求...), sex appeal (性感)】
example: The charity organization made an urgent appeal to the public for donations.
exampleTranslation: 这家慈善组织紧急呼吁公众捐款。(词根：pel (推动) / 构词：ap- (向) + peal (推动) → 推动向前 → 呼吁)

translation: n. 名声，声誉 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：fame, prestige】【派生词：reputable (adj. 声誉好的), reputed (adj. 著名的)】【固定搭配：have a reputation for (因...而闻名), damage one's reputation (损害名誉)】
example: The restaurant has a good reputation for its delicious food and excellent service.
exampleTranslation: 这家餐厅因其美味的食物和优质的服务而享有良好的声誉。(词根：put (思考) / 构词：re- (反复) + put (思考) + -ation (名词后缀) → 反复被大家思考评价 → 名声)

translation: n. 吸引；吸引力；吸引人的事物 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：appeal, charm】【派生词：attract (v. 吸引), attractive (adj. 有吸引力的)】【固定搭配：tourist attraction (旅游景点), main attraction (主要吸引力)】
example: The main attraction of this city is its rich historical and cultural heritage.
exampleTranslation: 这座城市的主要吸引力在于其丰富的历史和文化遗产。(词根：tract (拉) / 构词：at- (向) + tract (拉) + -ion (名词后缀) → 拉向自己 → 吸引力)

translation: v. 使稳定；使安定 (stabilize-stabilized-stabilized) 【易混淆词：steady, stable】【派生词：stability (n. 稳定性), stable (adj. 稳定的)】
example: The government took measures to stabilize the economy during the crisis.
exampleTranslation: 政府采取措施在经济危机期间稳定经济。(词根：stabil (稳定) / 构词：stabil (稳定) + -ize (使...) → 使稳定)

translation: n. 研究，调查；v. 研究，调查 (research-researched-researched) 【易混淆词：search, study, survey】【派生词：researcher (n. 研究员), researchable (adj. 可研究的)】
example: The scientist has been conducting research on renewable energy for many years.
exampleTranslation: 这位科学家多年来一直在对可再生能源进行研究。(词根：search (搜寻) / 构词：re- (反复/再) + search (搜寻) → 反复搜寻 → 研究，调查)

translation: n. 决定，决心；决议 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：choice, resolution】【派生词：decide (v. 决定), decisive (adj. 决定性的), decisively (adv. 果断地)】
example: It is important for us to make a wise decision when facing difficulties.
exampleTranslation: 面对困难时，做出明智的决定对我们来说很重要。(词根：cis/cid (切) / 构词：de- (离开) + cis (切) + -ion (名词后缀) → 切断(犹豫) → 决定)

translation: v. 最大化；使增至最大限度 (maximize-maximized-maximized) 【易混淆词：minimize (最小化), enlarge (扩大), optimize (优化)】【派生词：maximum (n. 最大值 adj. 最大的), maximization (n. 最大化)】
example: To maximize profits, the company decided to cut down on unnecessary expenses.
exampleTranslation: 为了最大化利润，公司决定削减不必要的开支。(词根：maxim (最大) / 构词：maxim (最大) + -ize (使...) → 使最大化)

translation: adv. 实际上，事实上；居然，竟然 (副词，无变形) 【易混淆词：currently, truly, in fact】【派生词：actual (adj. 实际的，真实的), actuality (n. 现实，实际情况), actualize (v. 实现)】
example: He looks very young, but he is actually over forty years old.
exampleTranslation: 他看起来很年轻，但实际上已经四十多岁了。(词根：act (做，行动) / 构词：act (做，行动) + -ual (形容词后缀) + -ly (副词后缀) → 实际地，事实上)

translation: adv. 大约，大概，近于 (副词，无变形) 【易混淆词：about, roughly, nearly】【派生词：approximate (adj. 大约的，接近的), approximation (n. 近似值)】
example: The flight takes approximately three hours from Shanghai to Beijing.
exampleTranslation: 从上海到北京的航班大约需要三个小时。(词根：proxim (最接近的) / 构词：ap- (向) + proxim (最接近的) + -ate (形容词后缀) + -ly (副词后缀) → 接近地 → 大约)

translation: adj. 至关重要的，决定性的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：critical, vital, essential, significant】【派生词：crucially (adv. 至关重要地)】
example: Teamwork is crucial to the success of the project.
exampleTranslation: 团队合作对项目的成功至关重要。(词根：cruc (十字/交叉) / 构词：cruc (十字/交叉) + -ial (形容词后缀) → 处在十字路口的 → 决定性的，至关重要的)

translation: v. 安装；任命；安顿 (install-installed-installed) 【易混淆词：equip (装备), fix (修理), setup (设置)】【派生词：installation (n. 安装；装置；就职), installer (n. 安装者/安装程序)】
example: You need to install this application before you can use its full features.
exampleTranslation: 在使用其全部功能之前，你需要先安装这个应用程序。(词根：stall (站立/位置) / 构词：in- (进入) + stall (站立/位置) → 安置于内 → 安装；任命)

translation: n. 面板；专家咨询组；陪审团 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：board, committee】【派生词：panelist (n. 专门小组成员)】
example: A panel of experts was invited to discuss the environmental issue.
exampleTranslation: 一个专家小组受邀讨论环境问题。(词根：pan (布/板) / 构词：pan (布/板) + -el (名词后缀) → 一块布/板 → 面板；专家小组)

translation: adj. 潜在的，可能的 n. 潜力，潜能 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：possible, latent】【派生词：potentially (adv. 潜在地), potentiality (n. 潜力)】
example: We should tap into the potential of renewable energy to reduce pollution.
exampleTranslation: 我们应该开发可再生能源的潜力以减少污染。(词根：potent (强有力的) / 构词：potent (强有力的) + -ial (形容词/名词后缀) → 具有力量的 → 潜在的；潜力)

translation: v. 咨询；商议；查阅 (consult-consulted-consulted) 【易混淆词：advise, negotiate】【派生词：consultant (n. 顾问), consultation (n. 咨询，磋商)】
example: You'd better consult your doctor before taking any new medicine.
exampleTranslation: 在服用任何新药之前，你最好咨询你的医生。(词根：sult (召集) / 构词：con- (共同) + sult (召集) → 召集在一起 → 商议；咨询)

translation: v. 侮辱，辱骂 n. 侮辱，辱骂 (insult-insulted-insulted) 【易混淆词：offend, abuse】【派生词：insulting (adj. 侮辱性的，无礼的)】
example: He felt deeply insulted by their unfair remarks.
exampleTranslation: 他因他们不公平的言论而感到深受侮辱。(词根：sult (跳) / 构词：in- (在...上) + sult (跳) → 跳上去踩踏 → 侮辱)

translation: n. 校园，校区 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：school, college】【派生词：campused (adj. 住在校内的)】
example: Many students live on campus during their first year of college.
exampleTranslation: 许多学生在大学第一年住在校内。(词根：camp (田野，平地) / 构词：camp (田野，平地) + -us (名词后缀) → 校园)

translation: v. 决定；查明；决心 (determine-determined-determined) 【易混淆词：decide, resolve】【派生词：determination (n. 决心；测定), determined (adj. 坚决的)】
example: The final score will determine whether you pass the exam or not.
exampleTranslation: 最终成绩将决定你是否通过考试。(词根：termin (界限) / 构词：de- (加强) + termin (界限) + -e → 划定界限 → 决定；查明)

translation: v. 集合，聚集；装配，组装 (assemble-assembled-assembled) 【易混淆词：gather, collect, construct】【派生词：assembly (n. 集会；装配), assembler (n. 装配工)】
example: The students were asked to assemble in the main hall at 8 a.m.
exampleTranslation: 学生们被要求早上8点在大礼堂集合。(词根：sembl (相似，一起) / 构词：as- (向) + sembl (一起) + -e → 向一起走 → 集合；装配)

translation: v. 变化，不同，改变 (vary-varied-varied) 【易混淆词：change, differ, alter】【派生词：variety (n. 多样；种类), various (adj. 各种各样的), variable (adj. 可变的 n. 变量)】
example: Prices of fruits and vegetables vary according to the season.
exampleTranslation: 水果和蔬菜的价格随季节而变化。(词根：var (变化) / 构词：var (变化) + -y → 变化；不同)

translation: v. 进餐，用餐 (dine-dined-dined) 【易混淆词：eat, feast】【派生词：diner (n. 用餐者；小餐馆), dinner (n. 晚餐)】
example: They often dine out with their friends on weekends.
exampleTranslation: 他们周末经常和朋友出去吃饭。(词根：din (用餐) / 构词：din (用餐) + -e → 进餐，用餐)

translation: v. 集中，专心；浓缩 n. 浓缩物 (concentrate-concentrated-concentrated) 【易混淆词：focus, gather】【派生词：concentration (n. 集中，注意力), concentrated (adj. 集中的，浓缩的)】
example: You must concentrate on your studies if you want to achieve good grades.
exampleTranslation: 如果你想取得好成绩，你必须专注于你的学业。(词根：centr (中心) / 构词：con- (共同) + centr (中心) + -ate (动词后缀) → 共同向中心靠拢 → 集中；专心)

translation: v. 保护，保存；维持 n. 保护区；果酱 (preserve-preserved-preserved) 【易混淆词：protect (保护), conserve (节约；保护), reserve (预订)】【派生词：preservation (n. 保护，保存), preservative (n. 防腐剂 adj. 防腐的)】【固定搭配：preserve the environment (保护环境), preserve cultural heritage (保护文化遗产), preserve peace (维护和平)】
example: We must take effective measures to preserve our cultural heritage.
exampleTranslation: 我们必须采取有效措施来保护我们的文化遗产。(词根：serv (保持，服务) / 构词：pre- (预先) + serv (保持) + -e → 预先保持 → 保护；保存)

translation: adj. 细长的；苗条的；微薄的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：thin, slim, slight】【派生词：slenderness (n. 苗条；细长)】
example: She has a slender figure and always looks elegant.
exampleTranslation: 她身材苗条，总是看起来很优雅。(词根：无 / 构词：slend (细长) + -er (形容词后缀) → 细长的)

translation: adj. 更好的，优越的；上级的 n. 上级，长官 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：better, higher, inferior (反义词)】【派生词：superiority (n. 优越性，优势)】
example: This model is far superior to the previous one in terms of performance.
exampleTranslation: 在性能方面，这款模型远优于前一款。(词根：super (上面) / 构词：super (在上面) + -ior (形容词比较级后缀) → 处于更高位置的 → 优越的)

translation: n. 容易；舒适，安逸 v. 减轻，缓解；放松 (ease-eased-eased) 【易混淆词：comfort, relief, difficulty (反义词)】【派生词：easy (adj. 容易的), easily (adv. 容易地)】
example: The new medicine can ease the pain of the patients effectively.
exampleTranslation: 这种新药能有效减轻病人的疼痛。(词根：无 / 构词：ease (舒适，容易) → 容易；减轻)

translation: n. 事件，事变；插曲 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：accident, event, affair】【派生词：incidental (adj. 偶然的，附带的), incidentally (adv. 顺便提一句；偶然地)】
example: The police are investigating the incident that happened last night.
exampleTranslation: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的事件。(词根：cid (落下) / 构词：in- (在...上) + cid (落下) + -ent (名词后缀) → 落在头上的事 → 事件)

translation: v. 使隔离，使孤立；分离 (isolate-isolated-isolated) 【易混淆词：separate, cut off, insulate】【派生词：isolation (n. 隔离，孤立), isolated (adj. 孤立的，偏远的)】
example: Patients with infectious diseases must be isolated from others immediately.
exampleTranslation: 传染病患者必须立即与他人隔离。(词根：isol (岛屿) / 构词：isol (岛屿) + -ate (动词后缀) → 使成为孤岛 → 隔离)

translation: adj. 特定的；特别的；挑剔的 n. 详情，细节 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：specific, special, general (反义词)】【派生词：particularly (adv. 特别地，尤其), particularity (n. 特性)】
example: He is very particular about the food he eats and the clothes he wears.
exampleTranslation: 他对吃的食物和穿的衣服非常挑剔。(词根：part (部分) / 构词：part (部分) + -icul (小) + -ar (形容词后缀) → 属于某个小部分的 → 特定的)

translation: adj. 抽象的；深奥的 n. 摘要，梗概 v. 提取，抽取 (abstract-abstracted-abstracted) 【易混淆词：concrete (反义词), summary, extract】【派生词：abstraction (n. 抽象；提取), abstractly (adv. 抽象地)】
example: It is difficult for beginners to understand such abstract concepts.
exampleTranslation: 初学者很难理解如此抽象的概念。(词根：tract (拉) / 构词：abs- (离开) + tract (拉) → 从具体中拉出来 → 抽象的；提取)

translation: v. 反射；反映；深思，考虑 (reflect-reflected-reflected) 【易混淆词：mirror, show, think】【派生词：reflection (n. 反射；映像；深思), reflective (adj. 反射的；深思的)】
example: The rising prices reflect the economic situation of the country.
exampleTranslation: 物价上涨反映了该国的经济状况。(词根：flect (弯曲) / 构词：re- (回) + flect (弯曲) → 弯曲回来 → 反射；反映)

translation: adj. 严厉的，严酷的；刺耳的；粗糙的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：severe, cruel, rough, gentle (反义词)】【派生词：harshly (adv. 严厉地；刺耳地), harshness (n. 严厉；粗糙)】
example: The workers had to work under harsh conditions to make a living.
exampleTranslation: 工人们为了谋生不得不在恶劣的条件下工作。(词根：无 / 构词：harsh (粗糙的，刺耳的) → 严厉的；恶劣的)

translation: v. 获得，取得；学到（技能等） (acquire-acquired-acquired) 【易混淆词：obtain, gain, achieve, require (要求)】【派生词：acquisition (n. 获得；收购), acquired (adj. 后天获得的)】
example: It takes time and effort to acquire a new language.
exampleTranslation: 学习一门新语言需要时间和努力。(词根：quir (寻求) / 构词：ac- (向) + quir (寻求) + -e → 向...寻求 → 获得)

translation: n. 芯片；碎片；炸薯条 v. 削，凿；打破 (chip-chipped-chipped) 【易混淆词：fragment, piece, crisp (薯片)】【派生词：chipper (adj. 爽朗的，活泼的)】
example: The computer has a new chip that makes it much faster.
exampleTranslation: 这台电脑有一个新芯片，使它运行快得多。(词根：无 / 构词：chip (碎片，芯片) → 芯片；碎片)

translation: n. 争论，辩论；纠纷 v. 争论，辩论 (dispute-disputed-disputed) 【易混淆词：argue, debate, conflict】【派生词：disputable (adj. 有争议的), disputant (n. 争论者)】
example: The two sides are in dispute over the ownership of the land.
exampleTranslation: 双方就土地所有权发生争议。(词根：put (思考) / 构词：dis- (分开) + put (思考) + -e → 分开思考 → 争论)

translation: n. 信念，信仰；相信 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：faith, conviction, disbelief (反义词)】【派生词：believe (v. 相信), believable (adj. 可信的)】
example: Nothing can shake his belief in the power of hard work.
exampleTranslation: 没有什么能动摇他对努力奋斗力量的信念。(词根：lief (爱/允许) / 构词：be- (加强) + lief (爱/允许) → 深深相信 → 信念)

translation: n. 储存，贮藏；存储 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：memory, preservation】【派生词：store (v. 储存 n. 商店), storeroom (n. 储藏室)】
example: We need more storage space for all these old books.
exampleTranslation: 我们需要更多的存储空间来放这些旧书。(词根：stor (储存) / 构词：stor (储存) + -age (名词后缀) → 储存)

translation: n. 规模；比例；刻度；天平 v. 攀登；按比例缩放 (scale-scaled-scaled) 【易混淆词：size, level, extent】【派生词：scaled (adj. 缩放的)】
example: The company has expanded its business on a global scale.
exampleTranslation: 该公司已在全球范围内扩展业务。(词根：scal (梯子/爬) / 构词：scal (梯子/爬) + -e → 梯子的刻度 → 规模；攀登)

translation: n. 信号；标志 v. 发信号；示意 (signal-signaled-signaled/signalled) 【易混淆词：sign, gesture, mark】【派生词：signaling (n. 信号传输)】
example: The mobile phone signal is very weak in this remote area.
exampleTranslation: 手机信号在这个偏远地区很弱。(词根：sign (记号) / 构词：sign (记号) + -al (名词/动词后缀) → 信号)

translation: v. 禁止，不许 (forbid-forbade-forbidden) 【易混淆词：ban, prohibit, allow (反义词)】【派生词：forbidden (adj. 禁止的), forbidding (adj. 令人生畏的)】
example: The school forbids students from smoking on campus.
exampleTranslation: 学校禁止学生在校园内吸烟。(词根：bid (命令) / 构词：for- (否定) + bid (命令) → 禁止)

translation: v. 加强，增强；巩固 (strengthen-strengthened-strengthened) 【易混淆词：reinforce, enhance, weaken (反义词)】【派生词：strength (n. 力量), strong (adj. 强壮的)】
example: Regular exercise can strengthen your muscles and improve your health.
exampleTranslation: 定期锻炼可以增强你的肌肉，改善你的健康。(词根：strength (力量) / 构词：strength (力量) + -en (使) → 加强)

translation: n. 图表；海图 v. 绘制图表；记录 (chart-charted-charted) 【易混淆词：graph, table, map】【派生词：charting (n. 制图)】
example: The chart shows the changes in the company's sales over the past five years.
exampleTranslation: 图表显示了公司过去五年销售额的变化。(词根：chart (纸/地图) / 构词：chart (纸/地图) → 图表)

translation: adj. 最初的，开始的 n. 首字母 v. 用姓名的首字母签名 (initial-initialed-initialed/initialled) 【易混淆词：original, first, final (反义词)】【派生词：initially (adv. 最初), initiate (v. 开始，发起)】
example: My initial reaction to the news was one of shock.
exampleTranslation: 我对这个消息的最初反应是震惊。(词根：it (走) / 构词：in- (进入) + it (走) + -ial (形容词后缀) → 开始走入 → 最初的)

translation: n. 度假胜地；求助，凭借 v. 求助，诉诸 (resort-resorted-resorted) 【易混淆词：recourse, holiday spot】【派生词：无】
example: If negotiations fail, we may have to resort to legal action.
exampleTranslation: 如果谈判失败，我们可能不得不诉诸法律行动。(词根：sort (出去) / 构词：re- (反复) + sort (出去) → 反复去的地方 → 度假胜地；求助)

translation: n. 原则，原理；准则 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：principal (主要的/校长)】【派生词：principled (adj. 有原则的)】
example: He is a man of principle and never tells lies.
exampleTranslation: 他是一个有原则的人，从不说谎。(词根：prin (第一) / 构词：prin (第一) + cip (拿) + -le → 拿第一的东西 → 原则)

translation: n. 风景，景色；舞台布景 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：scene (场景), view (视野/景色), landscape (风景)】【派生词：scenic (adj. 风景优美的), scenically (adv. 风景优美地)】
example: The scenery along the river is so beautiful that it attracts thousands of tourists every year.
exampleTranslation: 沿河的风景如此美丽，以至于每年吸引成千上万的游客。(词根：scen (场景) / 构词：scene (场景) + -ry (名词后缀，表总称) → 风景；舞台布景)

translation: adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：distant (遥远的), isolated (孤立的), faraway (遥远的)】【派生词：remotely (adv. 遥远地；稍微), remoteness (n. 遥远；偏僻)】【固定搭配：remote control (遥控器), remote area (偏远地区), remote possibility (极小的可能性)】
example: The internet has made it possible for people in remote areas to work from home.
exampleTranslation: 互联网使偏远地区的人们在家工作成为可能。(词根：mot (移动) / 构词：re- (回) + mot (移动) + -e → 移回去 → 遥远的)

translation: v. 拒绝；抛弃；排斥 n. 废品；被拒之人 (reject-rejected-rejected) 【易混淆词：refuse (拒绝), decline (拒绝；下降), accept (接受)】【派生词：rejection (n. 拒绝；抛弃)】【固定搭配：reject an offer (拒绝提议), reject a plan (拒绝计划)】
example: The manager rejected my application because I lacked experience.
exampleTranslation: 经理拒绝了我的申请，因为我缺乏经验。(词根：ject (扔) / 构词：re- (回) + ject (扔) → 扔回去 → 拒绝)

translation: adj. 当前的；流通的 n. 水流；电流；潮流 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：present (目前的), modern (现代的), flow (流动)】【派生词：currently (adv. 当前；目前), currency (n. 货币；流通)】【固定搭配：current situation (当前局势), electric current (电流), current affairs (时事)】
example: The current economic situation is much better than it was last year.
exampleTranslation: 当前的经济形势比去年好得多。(词根：cur (跑) / 构词：cur (跑) + -rent (形容词后缀) → 正在跑的 → 当前的)

translation: v. 维持；保养；主张；坚持认为 (maintain-maintained-maintained) 【易混淆词：preserve (保存), keep (保持), sustain (维持)】【派生词：maintenance (n. 维护；维持), maintainable (adj. 可维持的)】【固定搭配：maintain a balance (保持平衡), maintain good relations (保持良好关系), maintain that... (坚持认为...)】
example: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle as you get older.
exampleTranslation: 随着年龄增长，保持健康的生活方式很重要。(词根：tain (握持) / 构词：main (手) + tain (握持) → 用手握住 → 维持)

translation: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理学的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：mental (精神的), bodily (身体的), material (物质的)】【派生词：physically (adv. 身体上；物理上), physician (n. 内科医生), physicist (n. 物理学家)】【固定搭配：physical health (身体健康), physical exercise (体育锻炼), physical education (体育)】
example: Regular physical exercise is good for both your body and mind.
exampleTranslation: 定期的体育锻炼对你的身体和心灵都有好处。(词根：phys (自然；身体) / 构词：phys (自然；身体) + -ical (形容词后缀) → 身体的；物理的)

translation: adj. 最初的；原创的；新颖的 n. 原件；原作 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：initial (最初的), primary (主要的), creative (创造的)】【派生词：origin (n. 起源), originate (v. 起源), originally (adv. 最初), originality (n. 独创性)】【固定搭配：original plan (原计划), original idea (独创性想法), original text (原文)】
example: The original plan was to finish the project by Friday, but we had to change it.
exampleTranslation: 原计划是在周五前完成项目，但我们不得不改变它。(词根：ori (升起；开始) / 构词：ori (升起；开始) + gin (产生) + -al (形容词后缀) → 最初的)

translation: adj. 有责任的；负责的；可靠的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：reliable (可靠的), accountable (负有责任的), liable (有责任的)】【派生词：responsibility (n. 责任), responsibly (adv. 负责任地), irresponsible (adj. 不负责任的)】【固定搭配：be responsible for (对...负责；是...的原因), hold sb. responsible for (让某人对...负责)】
example: Parents are responsible for teaching their children good manners.
exampleTranslation: 父母有责任教孩子懂礼貌。(词根：spons (承诺；回答) / 构词：re- (回) + spons (承诺；回答) + -ible (形容词后缀) → 承诺回应的 → 有责任的)

translation: n. 罪犯 adj. 犯罪的；刑事的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：offender (违法者), guilty (有罪的), illegal (非法的)】【派生词：crime (n. 犯罪), criminally (adv. 犯罪地；刑事上)】【固定搭配：criminal law (刑法), criminal record (犯罪记录), war criminal (战犯)】
example: The police are searching for the criminal who robbed the bank.
exampleTranslation: 警方正在搜捕抢劫银行的罪犯。(词根：crimin (罪) / 构词：crimin (罪) + -al (形容词/名词后缀) → 犯罪的；罪犯)

translation: adj. 必要的；必不可少的；本质的 n. 要素；必需品 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：necessary (必要的), vital (至关重要的), crucial (关键的)】【派生词：essentially (adv. 本质上；基本上), essence (n. 本质；精华)】【固定搭配：be essential to/for (对...至关重要), essential elements (基本要素), essential oil (精油)】
example: Water is essential to all forms of life on Earth.
exampleTranslation: 水对地球上所有形式的生命都至关重要。(词根：ess (存在) / 构词：ess (存在) + -ential (形容词后缀) → 与存在相关的 → 本质的；必不可少的)

translation: adj. 学术的；学院的；纯理论的 n. 大学教师；学者 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：educational (教育的), scholarly (学者风度的), theoretical (理论的)】【派生词：academy (n. 学院；研究院), academically (adv. 学业上；学术上)】【固定搭配：academic performance (学业成绩), academic year (学年), academic research (学术研究)】
example: Students need to maintain a balance between academic study and social activities.
exampleTranslation: 学生需要在学业和社交活动之间保持平衡。(词根：academ (学院) / 构词：academ (学院) + -ic (形容词后缀) → 学院的；学术的)

translation: n. 碎片；片段 v. 破碎；使成碎片 (fragment-fragmented-fragmented) 【易混淆词：piece (块), scrap (碎片), shatter (粉碎)】【派生词：fragmentary (adj. 零碎的), fragmentation (n. 分裂；破碎)】【固定搭配：a fragment of (一小部分/碎片), fragment into (碎裂成)】
example: The vase broke into tiny fragments when it hit the floor.
exampleTranslation: 花瓶掉到地上时摔成了碎片。(词根：frag (打碎) / 构词：frag (打碎) + -ment (名词后缀) → 碎片)

translation: adj./adv. 更快的（地） (fast-faster-fastest) 【易混淆词：quick (快的), rapid (迅速的), swift (敏捷的)】【派生词：fast (adj./adv. 快的/快地), fasten (v. 系牢)】【固定搭配：faster and faster (越来越快), faster than (比...快)】
example: The pace of technological change is getting faster and faster every year.
exampleTranslation: 技术变革的步伐每年都变得越来越快。(词根：fast (快) / 构词：fast (快) + -er (比较级后缀) → 更快的)

translation: v. 遭受；忍受；受痛苦 (suffer-suffered-suffered) 【易混淆词：endure (忍受), bear (承受), sustain (遭受)】【派生词：suffering (n. 痛苦), sufferer (n. 受害者)】【固定搭配：suffer from (遭受；患...病), suffer a loss (遭受损失), suffer pain (忍受痛苦)】
example: Many people in that area are suffering from a serious shortage of clean water.
exampleTranslation: 那个地区的许多人正遭受着严重缺乏清洁水的痛苦。(词根：fer (带来) / 构词：suf- (在下面) + fer (带来) → 在下面承受 → 遭受)

translation: n. 机器；机械装置 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：device (装置), equipment (设备), mechanism (机制)】【派生词：machinery (n. 机器；机构), mechanic (n. 机械师), mechanical (adj. 机械的)】【固定搭配：washing machine (洗衣机), machine learning (机器学习), by machine (用机器)】
example: The new machine is much more efficient and saves a lot of time.
exampleTranslation: 这台新机器效率高得多，节省了大量时间。(词根：machin (机器) / 构词：machin (机器) + -e → 机器)

translation: adj. 有耐心的，能容忍的 n. 病人，患者 (形容词/名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：tolerant (宽容的), persistent (坚持的), impatient (不耐烦的)】【派生词：patience (n. 耐心), patiently (adv. 耐心地)】【固定搭配：be patient with (对...有耐心), patient care (病人护理)】
example: Teachers need to be patient with students who are slow learners.
exampleTranslation: 老师需要对学得慢的学生有耐心。(词根：pati (忍受) / 构词：pati (忍受) + -ent (形容词/名词后缀) → 能忍受的 → 有耐心的；病人)

translation: n. 特征；特色；面貌 v. 以...为特色 (feature-featured-featured) 【易混淆词：characteristic (特性), trait (特点), appearance (外貌)】【派生词：featureless (adj. 无特色的)】【固定搭配：special feature (特色), feature in (在...中起重要作用), key feature (关键特征)】
example: The new smartphone features a larger screen and a better camera.
exampleTranslation: 这款新智能手机拥有更大的屏幕和更好的摄像头。(词根：fact/feat (做，制作) / 构词：feat (做，制作) + -ure (名词后缀) → 做出来的样子 → 特征)

translation: v. 鼓励；支持；促进 (encourage-encouraged-encouraged) 【易混淆词：inspire (激励), motivate (激发), discourage (使气馁)】【派生词：encouragement (n. 鼓励), encouraging (adj. 令人鼓舞的)】【固定搭配：encourage sb. to do sth. (鼓励某人做某事), encourage investment (促进投资)】
example: Our teacher often encourages us to speak English as much as possible.
exampleTranslation: 我们的老师经常鼓励我们尽可能多地说英语。(词根：cour (心) / 构词：en- (使) + cour (心) + -age (名词后缀) → 使有心 → 鼓励)

translation: adj. 真正的，真实的；诚恳的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：real (真实的), authentic (真正的), fake (假的)】【派生词：genuinely (adv. 真诚地；真正地), genuineness (n. 真诚；真实)】【固定搭配：genuine leather (真皮), genuine concern (真诚的关心)】
example: She showed genuine interest in learning English.
exampleTranslation: 她对学习英语表现出真正的兴趣。(词根：genu (出生，产生) / 构词：genu (出生，产生) + -ine (形容词后缀) → 生来就有的 → 真正的)

translation: n. 手势，姿态；表示 v. 做手势，用动作示意 (gesture-gestured-gestured) 【易混淆词：sign (标志，手势), signal (信号), posture (姿势)】【派生词：gestural (adj. 手势的)】【固定搭配：make a gesture (做手势), a gesture of (一种...的表示), gesture for sb. to do (示意某人做)】
example: He made a gesture to tell us to keep quiet.
exampleTranslation: 他做了个手势叫我们保持安静。(词根：gest (带来，运) / 构词：gest (带来，运) + -ure (名词后缀) → 带来信息的动作 → 手势)

translation: adj. 致命的；灾难性的；命中注定的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：deadly (致命的), lethal (致死的), mortal (凡人的，致死的)】【派生词：fatally (adv. 致命地), fatality (n. 死亡；致命性)】【固定搭配：fatal accident (致命事故), fatal mistake (致命错误)】
example: The driver made a fatal mistake that cost him his life.
exampleTranslation: 司机犯了一个致命的错误，使他付出了生命的代价。(词根：fat (命运) / 构词：fat (命运) + -al (形容词后缀) → 命运决定的 → 致命的)

translation: v. 参加，参与 (participate-participated-participated) 【易混淆词：attend (出席), join (加入), take part in (参加)】【派生词：participation (n. 参与), participant (n. 参与者)】【固定搭配：participate in (参加，参与)】
example: All students are encouraged to participate in the school sports meeting.
exampleTranslation: 鼓励所有学生参加学校运动会。(词根：part (部分) / 构词：part (部分) + -cip (拿) + -ate (动词后缀) → 拿取一部分 → 参与)

translation: v. 发射；发起；开展；推出 n. 发射；产品发布 (launch-launched-launched) 【易混淆词：start (开始), initiate (发起), release (发布)】【派生词：launcher (n. 发射器)】【固定搭配：launch a campaign (发起运动), launch a product (推出产品), launch a satellite (发射卫星)】
example: The company plans to launch a new product next month.
exampleTranslation: 公司计划在下个月推出一款新产品。(词根：无 / 构词：launch (长矛，投掷) → 投掷出去 → 发射；发起)

translation: n. 账户；描述；解释 v. 解释；占...比例 (account-accounted-accounted) 【易混淆词：bill (账单), report (报告), description (描述)】【派生词：accountant (n. 会计), accounting (n. 会计学), accountable (adj. 有责任的)】【固定搭配：account for (解释；占据), take...into account (把...考虑在内), on account of (由于)】
example: Students' test scores account for 60% of their final grade.
exampleTranslation: 学生的考试成绩占期末成绩的60%。(词根：count (计算) / 构词：ac- (加强) + count (计算) → 仔细计算 → 账户；解释)

translation: v. 推荐；建议 (recommend-recommended-recommended) 【易混淆词：suggest (建议), advise (建议), propose (提议)】【派生词：recommendation (n. 推荐；建议)】【固定搭配：recommend doing sth. (建议做某事), recommend sb. to do sth. (建议某人做某事), highly recommend (强烈推荐)】
example: I highly recommend this book to anyone interested in history.
exampleTranslation: 我强烈推荐这本书给任何对历史感兴趣的人。(词根：mend (委托，命令) / 构词：re- (反复) + commend (委托，表扬) → 委托别人去办 → 建议；推荐)

translation: adj. 不锈的；无污点的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：spotless (一尘不染的), pure (纯洁的)】【派生词：stain (n. 污点 v. 弄污), stainlessly (adv. 不锈地)】【固定搭配：stainless steel (不锈钢)】
example: The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances.
exampleTranslation: 厨房配备了不锈钢电器。(词根：stain (污点) / 构词：stain (污点) + -less (无) → 无污点的 → 不锈的)

translation: adj. 以前的，先前的；早先的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：former (前者的), prior (先前的), subsequent (后来的)】【派生词：previously (adv. 先前，以前)】【固定搭配：previous experience (以前的经验), previous owner (前任主人)】
example: She has previous experience in teaching English to children.
exampleTranslation: 她有教儿童英语的经验。(词根：vi (路) / 构词：pre- (预先) + vi (路) + -ous (形容词后缀) → 提前走的路 → 以前的)

translation: n. 方面；样子，外观 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：side (方面), facet (方面), angle (角度)】【派生词：aspectual (adj. 方面的)】【固定搭配：in all aspects (在各方面), from this aspect (从这个方面)】
example: We must consider the problem from every aspect.
exampleTranslation: 我们必须从各个方面考虑这个问题。(词根：spect (看) / 构词：a- (向) + spect (看) → 向一个方向看 → 方面；外观)

translation: n. 代表；代理人 adj. 有代表性的，典型的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：delegate (代表), typical (典型的), represent (代表)】【派生词：represent (v. 代表), representation (n. 代表，表现)】【固定搭配：sales representative (销售代表), representative of (代表...的)】
example: He was chosen as the representative of our class to attend the meeting.
exampleTranslation: 他被选为我们班的代表去参加会议。(词根：sent (感觉，存在) / 构词：re- (再) + present (呈现) + -ative (形容词/名词后缀) → 再次呈现出来的人 → 代表)

translation: v. 探索；探测；探究 (explore-explored-explored) 【易混淆词：search (搜索), investigate (调查)】【派生词：exploration (n. 探索), explorer (n. 探险家), exploratory (adj. 探索性的)】【固定搭配：explore the possibility (探索可能性), explore nature (探索自然)】

translation: n. 首都；资本；大写字母 adj. 主要的；大写的 (名词/形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：capitol (美国国会大厦), major (主要的), funds (资金)】【派生词：capitalism (n. 资本主义), capitalist (n. 资本家), capitalize (v. 资本化；利用)】【固定搭配：capital city (首都), human capital (人力资本), make capital out of (利用...谋利)】

translation: adj. 永久的，永恒的；固定的 (形容词，无变形) 【易混淆词：lasting (持久的), eternal (永恒的), temporary (暂时的)】【派生词：permanence (n. 永久), permanently (adv. 永久地)】【固定搭配：permanent residence (永久居留权), permanent job (固定工作)】

translation: v. 指责；控告 (accuse-accused-accused) 【易混淆词：charge (指控), blame (责备), indict (起诉)】【派生词：accusation (n. 指控), accused (n. 被告 adj. 被控告的)】【固定搭配：accuse sb. of sth. (指控某人某事), be accused of (被指控...)】

translation: n. 保险；保险费 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：assurance (保证), guarantee (担保)】【派生词：insure (v. 投保), insurer (n. 保险公司)】【固定搭配：health insurance (健康保险), insurance policy (保险单), insurance company (保险公司)】

translation: v. 执行；实施；强迫 (enforce-enforced-enforced) 【易混淆词：implement (实施), execute (执行), reinforce (加强)】【派生词：enforcement (n. 执行), enforceable (adj. 可实施的)】【固定搭配：enforce the law (执法), enforce a rule (执行规则)】

translation: v. 位于；定位；找出...的位置 (locate-located-located) 【易混淆词：situate (使位于), spot (发现), find (找到)】【派生词：location (n. 位置), located (adj. 位于...的)】【固定搭配：be located in/at (位于), locate the source (定位源头)】

translation: v. 协调；配合 n. 坐标 adj. 同等的 (coordinate-coordinated-coordinated) 【易混淆词：cooperate (合作), organize (组织), adjust (调整)】【派生词：coordination (n. 协调), coordinator (n. 协调者)】【固定搭配：coordinate with (与...协调), coordinate efforts (协调努力)】

translation: n. 焦虑；担忧；渴望 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：worry (担忧), concern (关切), stress (压力)】【派生词：anxious (adj. 焦虑的), anxiously (adv. 焦虑地)】【固定搭配：anxiety about/over (对...的焦虑), relieve anxiety (缓解焦虑)】

translation: n. 通货膨胀；膨胀 (名词，无变形) 【易混淆词：deflation (通货紧缩), expansion (扩张)】【派生词：inflate (v. 使膨胀), inflationary (adj. 通货膨胀的)】【固定搭配：inflation rate (通货膨胀率), control inflation (控制通货膨胀)】
